scope: Independent candidate. Core StoryCityPolicy ABI, profile-gated Gateway query seam, puzzle bounds, and the COC begin/finish Store-result seam. No D8/APK/native evidence.

query_seam.resolver: LocalGatewayServer.q7QueryAreaId(Ljava/lang/Integer;Z[B)I private static regs5; resolution only, no sentinel
query_seam.gate: LocalGatewayServer.q7QueryAreaAllowed(Ljava/lang/Integer;[B)Z private static regs4; true for non-owned, null, legacy 1..8, catalog 9/10000..10003; false for owned unknown
query_seam.profile: exactly one authoritative load occurs before the gate/resolver (handleClient load, handleReliableRpc snapshot); same register is reused by the BsonLite reply; original post-resolver load removed; no provider call between gate and reply
query_seam.non_owned: allowed=true and q7QueryAreaId delegates to unchanged resolveAreaId(Integer,Z)I; original reply path preserved
query_seam.owned_known: allowed=true; q7 resolves null->strict?1:0, otherwise the requested area (1..8/9/10000..10003)
query_seam.owned_unknown: allowed=false; no areaInfoReplyDocument/areaStagesReplyDocument is called; handler sends existing client stub showMessageStr with message 该地区暂不支持查询; no city state mutation, no fake area entry, no empty ai, no callback-only
query_seam.consumer_basis: CityMember getAreaInfoRequest/getAreaStagesRequest are callback-less typed RPCs; CommonMember.showMessageStr displays a common message only; CityData areas_info/stage are untouched on the reject path
query_seam.resolveAreaId: byte-identical; referenced only inside q7 non-owned delegation
query_seam.reject_tail: reject goto targets the post-log tail assignment (logAt+8: client move-object v11,v9; reliable move-object/from16 v8,v29), skipping the original append(I) log block so reject register types do not merge with the log int path
query_seam.translation: dex2jar+javap entry bodies contain no d2j fail translate; handleReliableRpc is invoked on the host frame at runtime

query_only_followup: Implemented for the two Gateway area query RPCs only, profile-gated; no global 1..8 relaxation.

puzzle_seam.room: LocalPuzzleEngine$Room.<init> inserts const/4 v4,4 before the upper check and compares id<=4; lower id>=1 unchanged
puzzle_seam.clue: LocalPuzzleEngine$Clue.<init> inserts const/4 v3,4 after the cg iput; upper room check reuses v3 so cg (v5) lower bound is unchanged
puzzle_seam.preserved: rooms 1..3 and clues 1..16 untouched; no unrelated arrays/constants

coc_seam.begin: LocalGatewayServer.q7StoryCityCocBegin delegates only catalog COC scenes to StoryCityCocPolicy.begin, persists Progress through the real LocalTutorialStore before returning, and returns Settlement.storeResult; non-COC/foreign providers call the original updateEconomy.
coc_seam.finish: LocalGatewayServer.q7StoryCityCocFinish settles only on normal admission, or recovers a durable receipt with persisted pending and missing Progress completion by returning a synthetic win result for the original finishStoryCombat trace/save, with no second Store call and no reward.
coc_seam.store_result: StoryCityCocPolicy.Settlement.storeResult exposes the original LocalEconomyEngine.Result so the Gateway cache/control/reward frames are preserved.
